summary: Frontend-only static editorial homepage tested end-to-end. All requested features work: header/nav/mobile menu, hero, news feed with region filters (Europe=2, Asia-Pacific=2, All=8), 6 city cards, 6 tips, subscribe form validation (empty->error toast 'A valid email would help.', valid->success toast 'Welcome. First dispatch lands this Sunday.'), anchor navigation (#cities), footer. No console errors, no broken images (all Unsplash/Pexels images loaded).
critical_code_review_comments: Toasts from sonner are not dismissed between actions - both error and success toasts stack in the DOM during rapid interaction. Minor UX polish only.
Header 'today' date is computed at module import time (const outside component). If tab is left open past midnight the date won't refresh. Non-critical.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only site. Base URL https://cowork-global.preview.emergentagent.com. All data-testids present as spec'd. Region filter uses lowercased/space->dash slug (e.g. filter-region-asia-pacific). Subscribe uses sonner toast library.
